_comment: Words that give away a sentence about a model's governance, about the method, or about the document itself. A model page speaks about its subject; the rest lives in AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, the front door or the status line. Regular expressions; case is ignored unless a pattern opens with (?-i:. The subject of both trees is the method and the organization that runs it, so the method's own words — skill, validator, gate, Requester, scaffold — are the business here and stay off the list; what is caught is narration about a page's approval, its construction or its layout.
document: \b(?:this layer|the layer) (?:is derived|motivates|has no elements|is filled|holds only)\b
